answer: Reaching eligibility takes 50 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time anyone pays for every seat it wants. The signal register is checked at draw time, dune lists the eligible set, and violet seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 50 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh farm has no way to grade its own output. A 418 account operation therefore ties up 6 million dollars of idle capital. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
